subject: Report group description entry
notes: 'Each level 1 entry identifies a report group. The report group is defined by this entry and all its subordinate entries.' BindReportEntry opens a new ReportGroupModel on `level == 1` (int.TryParse, so `1` and `01` are the same). BindReportEntries computes each entry's subtree as the following entries of a higher level-number. ScreenReportEntryClausePresence derives elementary-ness from that same hierarchy. Probe gr1lvl (`1 D1 TYPE DE. 3 LINE 1. 5 COLUMN 1 ... 1 D2 TYPE DE. 3 LINE PLUS 1. 5 COLUMN 3 ...`, GENERATE D1 then D2) printed `A` on line 1 and `  B` on line 2: two groups, each built from its own subordinates. cite.py --check 13.15.4 'Each level 1 entry identifies a report group' -> OK. No existing spec-derived test is aimed at GR1 alone, so test-ref is empty. || Editions (adjudicator's statement, normalized to 85,2002,2014,2023 by registrar 14e): 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (the report group description entry is Report Writer nucleus syntax at every edition; no Annex E item changes §13.15 between 2014 and 2023)
